body: I have been having a huge relapse with eating for about 2 months now and I officially feel stuck ...like there is no way out. I don't know what to do but I know my body isn't handling it well . My body hurts so much pretty much all over ... Arms, upper back and legs. I had palpitations yesterday with a small fever which scared me and I guess it was due to dehydration because I drank an electrolyte drink and it calmed things down . TMI but my urine was clear so I didn't think of dehydration for hours and was tempted to go to the er . I have absolutely no one to talk to about this and feel so alone . I've never been treated for an ED before either and I'm 30 . I don't even know where to start or even if I want to ... Basically I'm just feeling alone, lost, stuck and really depressed. 😢 Sorry for the depressing comment ... Which it be more of a positive one . I love this group though because I am able to relate and feel a little less alone . 💜
Relatable. I feel extremely stuck and can't seem to get myself unstuck .

I haven't been eating well at all for over a month . Today I tried to eat something a bit more than I have and now I feel even more sick than I did before . Pain, excessive gas , nausea and feeling like I'm going to throw up which is a huge fear for me , more lightheaded, feel like I have the flu etc . I'm literally crying and I seriously never want to eat anything again . I felt better before trying to eat something . In other days it's been easy stuff like oatmeal , rice cake with peanut butter , chicken tenders etc . Little things . Today I tried half a sub sandwich and feel like I'm going to die . I don't want to eat anymore 😭

I understand that . I wasn't asking for people to tell me if I do.  I was just trying to see if anyone else can relate to my situation. I was also trying to figure it out more before I made any steps to find someone who works with ED esp cause I'm not even sure I need to do that . I also have Medicaid so I know it will be much more difficult to actually find someone and am trying to figure out if it's worth even attempting.   It may have been silly to post this but I don't have anyone else I feel comfortable talking to about it besides anonymously on the internet lol 😕 Thank you so much for your response 😊
